name: vesper-sieve
description: Short working rules for Claude Code and tools that stay asleep until they are needed.

deferred_tools.title: Sleeping tools
deferred_tools.description: Tools that stay out of the tool list until the model loads them through ToolSearch

loaded_tools.title: Loaded tools
loaded_tools.description: Tools that are always in the tool list, also when Claude Code would load them on demand

excluded_sections.title: Excluded sections
excluded_sections.description: Sections of the Claude Code system prompt that the plugin leaves out

excluded_tool_lines.title: Excluded tool lines
excluded_tool_lines.description: Phrases that mark lines of built-in tool descriptions the plugin leaves out because they conflict with its rules
default: If on the default branch, branch first

excluded_reminders.title: Excluded reminders
excluded_reminders.description: Kinds of reminders that Claude Code injects for the model and the plugin leaves out

restyle_marks.title: Rewritten marks
restyle_marks.description: Marks that make the plugin rewrite a sentence of a reply before it is shown, outside code, paths and links

restyle_turns.title: Rewritten contrast turns
restyle_turns.description: Phrases that mark a contrast turn the plugin rewrites, with parts that must appear in this order in one sentence separated by an ellipsis

restyle_possible_turns.title: Checked contrast turns
restyle_possible_turns.description: Phrases that may mark a contrast turn, which the plugin asks the model to rewrite only when it is one

restyle_swaps.title: Swapped characters
restyle_swaps.description: Each entry replaces its first character with the rest of the entry in the prose of a reply

restyle_max_chars.title: Longest rewritten block
restyle_max_chars.description: Text blocks longer than this many characters are shown as written, and 0 turns the rewrite off
